parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 99. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: Replication
parameters.description: Specifies whether to query replication target vaults.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the backup vault. Valid values:

- **UNKNOWN**: unknown
- **INITIALIZING**: initializing
- **CREATED**: created
- **ERROR**: error

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tag information. A maximum of 20 tags are supported.

parameters.name: VaultName
parameters.description: The name of the backup vault. The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: VaultOwnerId
parameters.description: The ID of the account to which the backup vault belongs.

parameters.name: VaultRegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the backup vault.

parameters.name: VaultType
parameters.description: The type of the backup vault. Valid values.
